nav.label: Review pages
nojs: This page needs JavaScript to keep and send your decisions. You can still read the claims.
footer.private: No account and no server: your decisions stay on this device until you send them.
reviewer.heading: Your reviewer ID
reviewer.intro: Enter the reviewer ID the maintainer gave you once. It starts with agt: and is kept on this device. Your name is never asked for, and never appears in these pages or in the file you send.
reviewer.label: Reviewer ID
reviewer.none: No reviewer ID on this device yet.
reviewer.invalid: That is not a reviewer ID: it is agt: followed by 22 letters and digits.
reviewer.saved: Saved. Decisions you make now are kept on this device under this ID.
reviewer.from_link: This link names the reviewer ID {id}. Save it if it is yours.
reviewer.needed: Enter your reviewer ID at the top of the page to start.
storage.off: This browser is not keeping your decisions (private browsing, or storage is blocked). Send them before you close this page.
index.title: Review queue
index.lens: Decisions are recorded in the first review board's lens: {label}. This is a declared default, not a claim to be neutral.
index.scope: These pages hold only what this scope covers: {scope}
index.how.heading: How it works
index.how.1: Open a batch. Each card is one claim, with its source beside it (below it on a phone).
index.how.2: Choose Accept, Reject or Needs discussion, and tick what you checked.
index.how.3: To accept a claim whose only basis is a document generated with AI, or that has no source in the graph, write the real source you checked: the work and the place in it. Never guess one.
index.how.4: Notes and citations are published with your decision, without your name. Do not write names, emails or phone numbers of reviewers in them.
index.how.5: Your decisions are kept on this device as you work, with or without a connection. When you are ready, press Send my decisions and send the file to the maintainer on WhatsApp or by email.
index.lead.story: Claims drawn from the 50 Stories document, one batch per story, in the document's order. The document was generated with AI, so these come first.
index.lead.person: The other claims, under the person they are about, A to Z.
index.lead.file: Claims about events and places only, by source file.
index.lead.identity: Records the graph treats as one person, place or event. Is that right?
index.empty: Nothing to review: this queue is empty.
index.clear.heading: Remove decisions from this device
index.clear.text: Do this only after the maintainer confirms your file was imported.
index.clear.button: Remove my decisions from this device
index.clear.confirm: Remove the {n} decisions kept on this device for {id}? Do this only after the maintainer confirms they were imported.

send.heading: Send my decisions
send.intro: One file holds every finished decision on this device under your reviewer ID, never your name. Send it to the maintainer on WhatsApp or by email. Sending again is safe: decisions already imported are skipped.
send.none: No finished decisions to send yet.
send.new.one: {n} of them is new or changed since you last sent.
send.new.other: {n} of them are new or changed since you last sent.
send.incomplete.one: {n} decision is not finished, so it is not sent yet:
send.incomplete.other: {n} decisions are not finished, so they are not sent yet:

send.saved: Saved the file {file}. Send it to the maintainer on WhatsApp or by email.
send.cancelled: Not sent: the share was cancelled. Your decisions are still on this device.
send.failed: Could not share the file ({error}). Use Save as a file instead.
